goal: Implement export function detectChallenge(html: string): boolean in challenge.ts. Return true only for a visible, active human-verification challenge that blocks the page. Ordinary listings, mentions of CAPTCHA or verification in prose/scripts, hidden challenge widgets, contact forms and search forms are not blocking challenges. The implementation must use document structure and context, not a bare keyword. Keep the function pure and preserve its signature. Development examples: a visible form action="/challenge" with captcha-response input and a Verify button under "Verify you are human" is true; two ordinary listing articles are false. Read the existing source before editing.

suite.requirement: Discriminate visible blocking challenges from ordinary content, hidden widgets, contact forms and script literals on the versioned development and held-out corpus. Every case must execute and pass without skips.
